2609.09133.title: ExecCritic: Learn to Test, Test to Improve for Coding Agents
2609.09133.paper_summary: Execution feedback can guide coding agents toward correct repository repairs, but only when the tests capture the behavior requested by the issue. Agent-generated tests can encode incomplete or incorrect behavioral targets; when the same trajectory writes both the patch and the test, their errors can agree and create false confidence. We introduce ExecCritic, combining a test--verify--revise scaffold with a role-specific reinforcement learning recipe for training agents within it. The scaffold separates test construction from source-code repair: a Test agent independently generates repository-native tests, a fail-closed harness qualifies and freezes them, and a Repair agent revises source code from their execution feedback without changing the tests. Both roles use Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B as the backbone and are trained separately. In Learn to Test, the Test agent learns to produce behaviorally valid tests that distinguish correct from incorrect patches. In Test to Improve, the Repair agent learns both direct task resolution and feedback-guided revision. On SWE-bench Verified, test quality determines whether feedback helps: holding the base Repair agent fixed, tests from the base Test agent reduce resolved rate from a no-test baseline of 61.2% to 57.3%, whereas tests from GPT-5.6-sol raise it to 65.3%. Role-specific post-training raises the Qwen Test agent's Base-to-Gold success from 22.2% to 62.2%; composing the two post-trained Qwen agents reaches 72.6%, an 11.4-point gain over the original no-test baseline without stronger-model or Oracle feedback at evaluation time. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/execcritic.
2609.09133.paper_summary_zh: 執行反饋可以指導編碼代理進行正確的庫修復，但前提是測試能捕捉到問題所要求的行為。代理生成的測試可能編碼不完整或不正確的行為目標；當同一路徑同時編寫補丁和測試時，它們的錯誤可能會一致，從而產生虛假的信心。我們介紹了ExecCritic，結合了測試--驗證--修訂的框架和一個針對角色的強化學習配方，用於訓練其中的代理。該框架將測試構建與源代碼修復分開：一個測試代理獨立生成庫本地測試，一個失敗關閉的裝置對其進行質量檢驗並凍結它們，而一個修復代理根據它們的執行反饋修訂源代碼，而不改變測試。兩個角色都使用Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B作為骨幹並分別訓練。在學習測試中，測試代理學會生成行為上有效的測試，以區分正確和不正確的補丁。在測試以改善中，修復代理學習直接任務解決和基於反饋的修訂。在SWE-bench Verified上，測試質量決定反饋是否有幫助：固定基礎修復代理，基礎測試代理的測試將解決率從無測試基線的61.2%降低至57.3%，而GPT-5.6-sol的測試則將其提高至65.3%。針對角色的後訓練將Qwen測試代理的基礎到金牌成功率從22.2%提高到62.2%；組合這兩個後訓練的Qwen代理達到72.6%，比原始無測試基線提高了11.4個百分點，且在評估時沒有使用更強的模型或Oracle反饋。代碼可在 https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/execcritic 獲得。
